name: Thunderroot Conductive Heartwood
description: A knot of rootwood laced with living current.
specialEffects: Used in shock maces, grounded hafts, and conductive striking frames.

steps: Refine raw stock for Thunderroot Conductive Heartwood under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Thunderroot Refinery protocol before storage.
